propositions: Snapshot janitor runs only in the review-bot process, leaving all other hosts' snapshot stores append-only and bloated (47 GiB measured on one developer host, never reclaimed)

A trigger pattern mirroring compact_trigger must be applied to gate resolution's tail, spawning detached GC passes on non-review-bot hosts when a cadence stamp is stale, holding no ticket-store lock and never raising
The trigger check must be O(1) — one stat of the stamp against interval_seconds — with no store enumeration and no lock acquisition on the quiet path
Single-flight overlap with the review-bot's resident janitor must degrade to skipped="locked" harmlessly, preserving both the resident thread and the stamp clock
Detached GC child must run under the snapshot store's own gc flock and stamped worker.lock sidecar, with durable cwd anchored at the store root, never inheriting ephemeral worktree paths
